spans.s: लित् an affix marked with the mute letter ल् such as ल्युट्, तातिल्, तल्, तसिल्, विधल्, भक्तल् etc. where the mute ल् signifies the acute accent for the vowel of the base which imme- diately precedes the affix; e. g. चिकीर्षक:;in which the vowel ई is acute; cf. लिति
लित्स्वर the acute accent for the vowel immediately preceding the affix caused by that affix being marked with the mute consonant ल्. See लित् above; cf. अनुदात्तत्वं क्रियतां लित्स्वर
